messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: abnormal token fanout detected across multiple edge POPs. 60s spike in requests attributed to a small set of bearer tokens. Suggested severity: P1.

maria (SRE): paging oncall @jon — seeing 6x baseline, backend 429s up 30%, tail latencies spiking on /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat.stream. Pattern: same token IDs used from 10+ geos within 5m.

jon (oncall): jumping in. any sign of customer-initiated rollout? matt can you confirm with support if any large customers are onboarding a bot?

matt (support): checked CRM and no active scheduled uploads. I messaged top 10 customers in last hour; no responses yet.

lee (security): initial fingerprinting shows identical user-agent string and simplistic accept headers. Likely credential stuffing / token leak or replay. Also seeing high volume of very small prompt payloads (embedding length < 128 tokens) which matches scraper patterns.

maria (SRE): ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply per-token circuit breaker to block tokens with > 100 req/min global; 2) enforce stricter per-token rate limits on embeddings and chat; 3) short WAF blocks for suspicious UA fingerprints and IP clusters; 4) reduce default anonymous quota temporarily.

jon (oncall): execute steps 1 and 2 now. I'll own oncall until 2307654567 handoff. maria, can you craft the rate-limit rule and push?

maria (SRE): applying rules in edge control plane now. Commands run:

```
POST /admin/rate-limits
path=/v1/embeddings scope=token limit=100 window=60
path=/v1/chat.stream scope=token limit=80 window=60
```

maria (SRE): enabling token circuit breaker config: block when token triggers >3 distinct POPs in 60s and rate >200 req/min. Also enabled short blocklist TTL 15m for matching UA.

ops-bot: deploy started for edge-rate-limit-service v2.3 by maria — health checks in progress.

jon (oncall): good. lee, please add WAF signatures for the UA and create geo IP sets for rapid blocking if fanout persists.

lee (security): added WAF ruleset rule id 4421 to block UA substring "ScrapeBot/1.0" and added IP ranges from suspicious cluster to temporary deny list. Also flagged related session ids for forensic export.

matt (support): started drafting customer notice template in case we need to inform affected customers about quota reductions or token revocations. Suggest: mention short service degradation for abuse mitigation and offer restore steps.

maria (SRE): quick metrics update: request qps from flagged tokens dropped ~70% after rate limits, 429s fell to baseline, but errors for some legitimate customers increased — seeing a handful of support tickets about rate-limiting.

jon (oncall): put a soft fallback: for tokens flagged by circuit-breaker, route to reduced-throughput tier instead of immediate block for first 10m, to reduce false positives. Update rule: first action = throttle to 10 r/min, second = block.

maria (SRE): rule updated. Also disabled auto-batching on embeddings for tokens in throttle mode to reduce amplification.

lee (security): runbook step: if token appears compromised, coordinate with account owner to rotate credentials. We should consider revoking sessions if forensic evidence shows brute force.

matt (support): support update: 4 customers received soft-throttle messages. One large customer reported spike due to internal regen script; we escalated and recommended rotating keys.

jon (oncall): action items before handoff at 2307654567:
- maria: monitor flagged token list and adjust thresholds if we see false positives.
- lee: continue IP/WAF block tuning and feed IOCs to edge.
- matt: prepare customer comms and support playbook for rotation steps.

maria (SRE): note: I saved the edge rule diffs to git commit id edge-rules@a7f3c. If we need to rollback, rollback window = 10m.

ops-bot: deploy completed: edge-rate-limit-service v2.3 — all instances healthy.

jon (oncall): summary for post-incident: root cause suspected token leak or automated reuse; mitigations were per-token circuit breakers, temporary WAF blocks, throttle-first policy, reduced anonymous quotas, and disabling embedding batching for flagged tokens. Net customer impact: brief soft-throttling for ~6 customers, one required rotation.

lee (security): collecting artifacts for full postmortem: UA samples, IP clusters, token usage timeline, and decision log. Will attach to final incident doc.

matt (support): support tickets opened: INC-8432, INC-8433. Replied to affected customers with rotation guidance.

jon (oncall): handing off to @maria at 2307654567. I'll be reachable if escalations. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:

maria (SRE): taking over monitoring. Leaving temporary rules in place for now; will coordinate final rollback/perm plan after signal stabilizes.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2307654500 based on stabilization.

lee (security): filing follow-up: propose stricter default per-token caps for anonymous use and evaluate telemetry to detect token reuse patterns earlier.

maria (SRE): noted. closing thread once postmortem linked.
